visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair sits in a dental treatment chair, wearing a plaid shirt and a light blue medical bib. He looks around a sterile clinic room with white marbled walls and stainless steel medical cabinets. (2) A male doctor wearing a green medical scrub jacket and glasses enters the frame, smiling and laughing while greeting the patient. A female assistant in a black uniform and mask is briefly visible in the background. (3) The patient lies down as the doctor stands over him, gesturing with his hands to explain a process. Bright studio-style lighting illuminates the scene. (4) Extreme close-up shots show the patient's open mouth. The doctor uses two wooden cotton swabs to carefully inspect the upper teeth and gums, which show signs of surgical hardware. (5) The patient talks to the camera and the doctor, showing expressive facial movements despite some swelling. (6) A small picture-in-picture insert shows the patient in a hospital bed from a previous day. The video ends with the patient lying back and giving a thumbs-up gesture.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Interaction -> Detail -> Reflection -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a post-surgery follow-up visit for orthognathic (jaw) surgery. It focuses on the humorous rapport between the patient and his surgeon, using a comedy-vlog editing style to normalize a medical procedure and share recovery milestones (8 days post-op).
